1318 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
255 days before 08-13:  
Back up 8 months to Dec 13 of previous year? Let's count days:  
From 08-13 back 31+30+31+30+31+28+31+30 = 242 days (Jan 13 to Aug 13 is 242 days in common year).  
255 - 242 = 13 days earlier than Jan 13.  
Jan 13 minus 13 days = Dec 31 of 1317.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1317-12-31
